reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent source-semantic review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP and Radare2 6.2.0 on retail igi.exe; candidate translation unit recompiled with the repository -O3 flags.
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/model/iff_chunk_tree.cpp hashes to 69b2e71f88a595c3cfcccf5b40df8c3ca54412b41ff46f09a0585175dc050ace. The retail entry was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view and independently recovered with Radare2; both graphs are recorded in the referenced evidence files and agree at 1.000 on nodes and edges. The candidate source and its compiled object symbol were then read against that reconstruction. This review supersedes the earlier evidence that was stale against the current source digest.

retail_function.name: Terrain_RenderWaterSurface_6
retail_function.summary: 0x005179C0: one basic block; loads the dword at chunk+0x1C and returns it (no callee, no branch).

candidate_function.summary: IffChunk_GetPayload(const IffChunkNode*): returns node->payload.data() when the port payload buffer is non-empty, otherwise nullptr.

checks.name: function_boundary
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and Radare2 recover 16 bytes, 1 block/0 edges; cfg_similarity 1.0.

checks.name: offset
checks.detail: Both return the chunk+0x1C payload pointer; the port maps it to the payload vector data pointer.

checks.name: empty_payload
checks.detail: Retail returns whatever dword is at +0x1C. The port returns nullptr for an empty payload vector rather than an allocated empty buffer address; callers that only test non-null are equivalent, raw address identity is not.

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail takes void* and returns the raw dword at +0x1C; the candidate takes const IffChunkNode* and returns the payload data pointer. The 32-bit pointer width and cdecl are preserved.

behavioural.method: Retail bytes execute under unicorn x86-32 over a synthetic IFF chunk graph laid out as the retail walk reads it (sibling +0x08, first child +0x0C, tag/FORM marker +0x10, form type +0x14, payload +0x1C). The candidate tree is rebuilt in the same shape and run under CrossOver. Both sides report whether a node was found and which node index the walk selected.

limitations: The port returns nullptr for empty payloads instead of a raw retail pointer value.
Generated graphs only; no live paired runtime capture.
The behavioural differential is emulator/host execution (VEX, Unicorn or angr plus the compiled candidate), not a live paired retail/candidate game process.
The CFG agreement cited here is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image; angr CFGFast was not rerun for this rebind.
cfg_similarity 1.0 is not a candidate-vs-retail CFG score; the candidate machine CFG was not compared for isomorphism.
